## Checking `one.go`

The **first** thing to settle is which of these holds:

- the file was read before it was written
- the file was written before it was read

```go
func main() {
	println("one")
}
```

So read_file has to come before write_file.
A plain thought with no markup in it at all.

## Every way markup can stand in a thought ## - intraword foo_bar_baz and snake_case_name - leading _private - trailing trailing_ - dunder __init__ - emphasis *one* _two_ **three** ***four*** ~~five~~ ~six~ - nested *foo_bar* and x*y*z - code `**kept**` and `foo_bar` and ``a ` b`` - unclosed ` tick - arithmetic 2 * 3 * 4 and a ** b - tildes ~/proj and ~5 - brackets items[0] and map[key] and [a][b] - link [the docs](https://example.com/a_(b) "title") and [**bold** label]() - autolinks and and html - pictures ![a picture](one.png) and ![](two.png) - escaped \*star\* and \_under\_ and \$5 and 50\% - entities & © A and &unknown; - a hard\ break 1. first 2) second ````md ``` inner_x *y* ``` ````

| what | when |
| --- | --- |
| read | first |
| write | second |
The read came first, and the file holds `one`.
